 ({'from':'missing','to':'edge','role':'x','attempts':0},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':'bad'},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':-1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1},{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for req,expected in checks:
 before_req=copy.deepcopy(req); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy); actual=evaluate(req,policy); assert actual==expected,(req,actual,expected); assert req==before_req and policy==before_policy
print('boundary checks passed')
